text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — nightly link-scan flagged 3 dead anchors in /kb/onboarding/quick-start.md and one stale external gist (404). Anyone owning that area?
link-scan-bot: results attached: 3 dead anchors (quick-start.md lines 42, 89, 210), external gist 404 -> https://gist.github.com/old/snippet. Re-run scheduled after fixes.
Preeti: I own onboarding but I'm heads-down on infra today. can we do a small patch? i can verify later.
Alex: I can patch the anchors and add redirect frontmatter for the deprecated slugs. Which redirect pattern do we prefer — permanent redirect to the anchor, or keep old shortlink + redirect_from? @Preeti
Carlos: I can take the gist rehost — I already have a local copy of the snippet. ping me the target path.
Alex: quick grep to find suspect anchors:```rg "href=.*#" docs/kb/onboarding/quick-start.md -n```  will open branch fix/kb/onboard-anchors and sed out the bad fragments.
Preeti: :thumbsup: let's use redirect_from in the frontmatter for the shortlinks, and canonical -> /kb/onboarding/quick-start#setup. small PR is perfect.
Alex: Opening WIP PR in ~15m. PR will include: 1) anchor adjustments, 2) frontmatter redirect_from for old slugs, 3) updated curl example (still small). WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 (WIP). @Jamie can you eyeball the rendering when it's ready?
Jamie: can review after standup. small thing: include a rendered screenshot or snapshot test for the curl snippet so we don't regress rendering between builds.
Alex: will add a tiny snapshot in tests/docs-snapshots and a short PR description. Also adding a changelog bullet.
Carlos: gist rehost PR done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1235 — gist now copied to /static/gists/onboard-snippet.md and the external link replaced. cc @Preeti
Preeti: thanks all :sparkles: i'll run a quick smoke locally after merges and then reassign the onboarding pages in the docs owners sheet to the "onboarding" team.
Alex: marking KB ticket resolved in Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/KB-789 - will update with PR links once merged.
link-scan-bot: noted fixes; will re-run nightly and report back.
Jamie: LGTM pending tiny test addition.
Alex: thanks team — ping here when reviews are posted and i'll merge after tests pass. :pray:
